title: Holiday Shopping Made Easy | Pinterest Newsroom
summary: Pinterest makes holiday shopping inspired, personal, and easy with new AI tools like Pinterest Assistant, Compare and Wishlists.
body_markdown:
Last season, 75% of holiday shoppers said Pinterest helped them narrow down their options to buy.1 And 57% of people say there’s a distinction between everyday shopping, which can feel like a chore, and discovering things they genuinely love.2


With new tools including Pinterest Assistant, Compare, Wishlists and holiday boards, Pinterest helps shopping be more inspired, personal and easy to act on. Pinterest is making sure[AI helps people shop without taking the enjoyment of shopping away](https://newsroom.pinterest.com/news/pinterest-yougov-poll-research) .


#### **The holiday ideas people are searching for**


People come to Pinterest early in the season to imagine what they’ll wear, make, give and gather around. This year’s holiday searches reveal a season that feels more personal, fun and hands-on.


From Mahjong searches, up **252%** , to creative ways to make every present feel more special, people are looking beyond the gift itself. Searches for “luxury Christmas wrapping paper” are up **246%** , while “gift card presentation ideas” have grown **620%** , proof that thoughtful details matter just as much as what’s inside. Holiday makers are also embracing ideas they can create, with searches for useful DIY gifts up **1,370%** , Christmas appetizer ideas up **1,100%** and Christmas coquette nails up **969%** year over year.


#### **Turn holiday questions into ideas you can act on**


Holiday planning comes with plenty of questions: What should I buy? How do I make it? Which option is right for me? **Pinterest Assistant** brings conversational AI to the forefront, helping people turn questions into personalized ideas through natural, multi-turn conversations. In a new full-screen experiment, people can explore ideas, ask follow-up questions and refine their plans in one place.


Someone might ask for “holiday gift ideas for the friend who has everything,” “holiday decor ideas for a festive evening” or “how to style a holiday sweater.” Pinterest Assistant can bring together visual inspiration, useful guidance and product suggestions tailored to what someone is exploring, their taste and their plans. Pinterest Assistant is fully ramped on iOS in the US.


#### **Compare options and choose with confidence**


Choosing between two great gift options can be harder than finding them in the first place. Now, with the new **Compare** feature, people can weigh the details that matter once they have found multiple promising ideas.


Shoppers can see similar products side by side, with information like price, availability and reviews, making it easier to choose the right gift before they buy. Compare is available through Pinterest Assistant and boards on mobile and through the Closeup button on desktop to users in the US.


#### **Save the finds worth coming back to**


Shoppers aren’t always ready to buy right away, even when they find something they love.Wishlists give people a dedicated place to save products they love, making it easy to revisit them when the time is right.


Wishlists can also notify shoppers when tracked products drop in price or come back in stock, helping them stay on top of savings and avoid missing the items they want most. People can create a Wishlist to share with family or use it to keep track of gifts for everyone on their list. Wishlists are currently in a limited iOS test across the US and Canada.


#### **More ways to discover holiday ideas and deals**


As a visual search and shopping platform, Pinterest is built for this kind of open-ended discovery, helping people turn ideas into action when it matters most. These holiday features are powered by Pinterest Intelligence, which brings together Pinterest’s first-party signals, visual understanding technology and purpose-built AI models to make discovery more personal, relevant and actionable.


Beyond these core shopping tools, Pinterest will bring even more holiday inspiration to life across the platform with new global features.


**Deal Boards** , hand-picked by Pinterest editors, help people discover trending deals on the products they’re searching for most, from sale finds to timely seasonal picks. Pinterest also features curated holiday deals from top LTK creators, including[Shakira Patterson](https://www.pinterest.com/occasionsbyshakira/) and[Anna Mae Groves](https://pin.it/1M9vaAk9E) , who share their favorite finds for busy shoppers on the go. Additionally, **Gift Guide Boards** make it easy to browse shoppable ideas for everyone on a holiday list.


All season long, Pinterest is helping people discover, save and shop for gifts that make the season more meaningful.
